purpose: Extend the selected Field Notes visual style to remaining PaperMono pages; reference images only.

boards.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create realistic, production-quality UI designs with clear hierarchy, strong typography and purposeful spacing.
Primary request: extend the already selected PaperMono Field Notes design language to the remaining existing pages of the zephyr-mono e-paper firmware. This is a coherent family of pages, NOT alternative visual directions.
Input image 1 is the ACTUAL IMPLEMENTED style reference, not an edit target. Match its crisp Chinese Song/Mincho serif headings, elegant serif numerals, fine straight rules, black line icons, generous white space and flat editorial layout. Source project: zephyr-mono; style defined in DESIGN.md. Keep an embedded reading terminal's quiet, practical feel.
Target dimensions: one wide reference board, 2560 x 960 pixels. Exactly FIVE complete portrait application screens in a single left-to-right row. Each individual viewport is 480 x 800, unchanged 3:5 aspect ratio. Screen top=128, bottoms=928, column x origins=32,536,1040,1544,2048, 24px white gutters. Board heading above screens. No phone/device shell, no perspective, no shadows, no notch, no rounded masking, no browser chrome.
Style: pure black ink on pure white paper; no gray fills, no colors, gradients, textures, dithering or drop shadows. Square outlines only for real interactive buttons, thin horizontal lines separate ordinary list rows. Do not enclose every content item in a card. Never stack cards inside cards. Selection: one short black vertical stroke at left, or a short black underline; no gray selected fill. Use only two font families: Chinese Source Han Serif style for large section names and primary content, Source Han Sans style for tiny labels and metadata; Latin numbers may have Bodoni-like serif forms already seen in the reference. Small branding PAPERMONO at screen top, 40–46px serif page heading, 24–28px primary list content, 16–20px metadata, outer content inset22px. Fine rule below heading. Stable footer y724, thin top rule, left back affordance “‹ 返回”, factual count/status right; paging hints small and unobtrusive.
Composition: each screen shows one focused existing workflow with clean hierarchy and a clear main purpose. Use spacing, grouping and typography first, rules second, outlined controls only where necessary. Comfortable gaps, readable Chinese, no clipped labels, no cramped table layouts. Do not add menus, search inputs, filters, compose buttons, account login, cloud sync, metrics or features not specified below.
Date anchor: 2026-09-30 Wednesday, timezone Asia/Shanghai. 2026-10-01 is Thursday; 2026-10-02 is Friday. All data is synthetic concept data, not device measurements. Include small board-wide caption “设计参考 · 示例数据 · 480 × 800” beneath the board heading. Do not put fictional battery percentages anywhere.
Text must be correctly rendered Simplified Chinese. No lorem ipsum, no English stand-ins for Chinese body text, no gibberish.
Board heading: “FIELD NOTES / 个人内容”.
Screens left to right:
1. 书库 — small “5 本书” under heading. Five generous list rows with tiny outlined typographic book spines, title and format/size only, right chevron. Rows: “雪国” / “EPUB · 462 KiB”; “山间来信” / “TXT · 86 KiB”; “时间的形状” / “EPUB · 1,280 KiB”; “旅途札记” / “TXT · 128 KiB”; “纸上风景” / “EPUB · 720 KiB”. First row selected with a short left ink bar. Do not fabricate author or illustrated covers because the ordinary library only has file metadata. Footer: “01 / 01” and tiny “轻触打开 · 长按扫描”.
2. 微信读书 — subtitle “本地书架摘要”. Exactly three clean typographic book rows. “雪国” author “川端康成”, “阅读进度 37%”, a fine black progress line; “乡土中国” author “费孝通”, “阅读进度 12%”; “小王子” author “安托万·德·圣埃克苏佩里”, “尚未开始”. Metadata “更新于 09月30日”. Generous blank space below. Small note “通过内容中心导入摘要”. No credential login, no cloud fetch, no book purchase or body download.
3. 日历 — elegant large serif “30” with “九月 / 周三” beside it, compact “2026” below. Agenda list, NOT a month grid. Separator then “今天” group: “09:30” / “编辑讨论排版”; “14:00” / “校对阅读样张”. Next group “10月01日 · 周四”: “全天” / “整理十月计划”; “10:00” / “阅读小组”. Thin separators, clear aligned time column, no add-event/edit button. Footer “01 / 02”.
4. 待办 — subtitle “3 项未完成”. Five rows with real square checkboxes, primary task title, due date/priority metadata. Unchecked “整理本周阅读笔记” / “09月30日 · 优先级 2”; unchecked “回复排版校对意见” / “10月01日 · 优先级 1”; unchecked “导入十月日程” / “10月02日 · 优先级 2”; checked “备份便签资料” / “已完成”; checked “同步阅读书架” / “已完成”. Completed text remains black; use checkbox mark rather than gray text. Footer small “轻触勾选” and “01 / 01”. No composer.
5. 便签 — list page, subtitle “4 篇便签”. Four airy rows with folded-page line icon or small mark, title and filetype. “阅读摘记” / “Markdown · 已收藏” with a filled small black bookmark; “十月计划” / “Markdown”; “山间来信” / “TXT”; “设备使用备忘” / “Markdown”. Small secondary line below first “关于留白与阅读节奏”. Footer “长按收藏” and “01 / 01”. Read-only import workflow, no pencil, no editing keyboard.
Ensure all five complete screens are equally sized and visually cohesive with the attached actual firmware UI.

Board heading: “FIELD NOTES / 连接与设备”.
Screens left to right:
1. 内容中心 — subtitle “在浏览器中管理内容”. Three rule-separated sections. “首次配网”: “网络  PaperMono-Setup”, “密码  仅作示例”, address “192.168.4.1” set large with elegant numerals. “浏览器配对”: instruction “打开设备地址，输入一次性配对码”, large spaced digits “482 619” and small “示例配对码”. “局域网”: “尚未连接”; “管理内容”: compact text “书籍 · 日历 · 待办 · 便签”. NO cloud services, login form, QR code, or upload-on-device button.
2. 遥控器 — small truthful demo status “演示状态 · 已连接”. Flat mode tabs “媒体   演示   鼠标”, short underline on 媒体. Main two-column by three-row separated square outlined control grid with plenty of internal space: icon + “播放 / 暂停”, speaker-cross + “静音”, previous-track + “上一首”, next-track + “下一首”, minus/speaker + “减小音量”, plus/speaker + “增大音量”. Clean black line icons match attached launcher vocabulary. Keep connection state distinct from actions. Footer “顶部切换模式” right. No fake player title or cover, no realtime animation, no battery percentage.
3. 信息卡片 — show authentic initial state rather than invented stock/weather feeds. Large folded-page geometric line icon in spacious upper center. Heading “尚未配置数据源”. Short text “添加数据源后，这里将显示标题、摘要和更新时间。” Below a thin rule, small section “离线时” then “保留最近缓存，并显示更新时间。” No configure button because source configuration is outside this device page. Footer small “等待内容更新”. White space is intentional, not a generic empty boxed card.
4. 硬件工具 — compact diagnostic list grouped by thin horizontal rules, no oversized tiles. First row “系统与触摸” with right arrow and subtitle “轻触查看系统状态”; “TF 存储” value “待检测”; “IMU” value “尚无有效采样”; “NFC” value “射频未验收”; “LoRa” value “默认禁止发射”; “麦克风与提示” value “待检测”; “BLE 小数据同步” value “未连接”. Small overall label “示例状态”. No fake live signal plot, no active radio TX button, no READY hardware acceptance claims.
5. 系统状态 — subtitle “PaperMono C153”. Group “固件”: aligned key/value rows “处理器 / ESP32-S3”, “系统 / Zephyr 4.4.1”, “界面 / LVGL 9”, “屏幕 / SSD1677”, “分辨率 / 480 × 800”, “运行时间 / —”. Group “电源”: “电池电压 / —”, “输入电压 / —”, “输出电压 / —”. Group “存储”: “TF / 待检测”, “NVS / 192 KiB”. Never draw battery percentages or fabricate measured telemetry. Restrained type, ample whitespace.
Ensure all five complete screens are equally sized and visually cohesive with the attached actual firmware UI.

Board heading: “FIELD NOTES / 偏好与阅读”.
Screens left to right:
1. 设置 — airy grouped flat list. Group “日常偏好”: row “自动休眠” / “10 分钟” chevron; “时间格式” / “24 小时制” chevron; “前光亮度” / “50%”, small 5-step discrete track with the third marker selected (levels0,25,50,75,100, NOT a continuous slider). Group “连接”: “重新配置 Wi-Fi” chevron; “清除蓝牙配对” chevron. Group “设备”: “恢复默认设置” with tiny “长按后确认”; “电源选项” chevron. No OS switches or complex scrollbars. Footer “轻触修改 · 右滑返回”.
2. 电源 — SHOW the existing full-page shutdown confirmation state. Big simple power-line icon above large serif heading “确认关机？”. Short primary explanation “设备将完全关机。” Secondary two-line explanation “仅可通过电源键重新启动。” Intentional empty white space. Two large square outlined controls near lower third, stacked with a small gap: “确认关机” and “取消”. First may use slightly heavier black border, no gray fills. Footer “取消可返回上一页”. No fictitious countdown, battery claim or background modal dimming.
3. 阅读菜单 — book subtitle “雪国”. Seven simple ruled rows, avoid boxed cards: small bookmark-line icon “添加当前页书签”; “目录” with right chevron; “排版与编码” with subtitle “标准 · UTF-8”; “前光亮度” with right-aligned “50%”; “书签列表” / “3 个位置”; “返回阅读”; “返回书库”. Small secondary hint under density row “轻触密度 · 长按编码” only when TXT but this screen is EPUB, so use “轻触切换密度” instead. Footer “进度与书签自动保存”. Touch sizes generous and content fits above footer.
4. 目录 — subtitle “雪国 · EPUB”. Five hierarchical chapter entries with tiny serif ordinal and thin row rules. “第一章  冬日来信” / small “章节 1 / 8”; indented child “一  越过山岭” / small “层级 2”; “第二章  雪夜” / small “当前章节” with small left black selection stroke; indented child “一  灯火与旅人”; “第三章  山间清晨”. No invented chapter page numbers or total book pages. Footer “轻触跳转” and “01 / 02”.
5. 书签 — subtitle “雪国 · 3 个位置”. Three generously spaced bookmark entries, no cards. Tiny bookmark-line icon then text snippet: “穿过山间的清晨。” / metadata “第一章 · 文件位置 1024”; “灯火映在窗上。” / metadata “第二章 · 文件位置 4096”; “远处的山脊渐渐明亮。” / metadata “第三章 · 文件位置 8192”. First row with short ink selection bar. Lower white space. Footer “轻触跳转” and “01 / 01”. Only use stored snippet/location metadata, no fake absolute page totals.
